Name: Soundpad Controller
Description: Play your Soundpad sounds from the keys: fixed favorites, a library you browse by category and page, and playback controls. Windows only; needs Soundpad running. Not affiliated with Leppsoft.

Actions.Name: Library position
Actions.Tooltip: Shows a category or sound from the library page.

Actions.Name: Library navigation
Actions.Tooltip: Moves the library: pages, categories and back.

Actions.Name: Playback control
Actions.Tooltip: Stop, pause, next, previous, random, replay or volume.

Localization.Title: Title
Localization.Show the name on the key: Show the name on the key
Localization.mode.pause: Play, then pause or resume when pressed again
Localization.mode.restart: Stop the current sound, then play
Localization.volume.note: Volume changes Soundpad's speaker volume, as its own slider does.
Localization.group.note: Every key with the same group name works together. Give a second set of keys another name to browse separately.
Localization.group.positions: 0 counts the position keys on the deck.
Localization.note.local: Talks to Soundpad only on this computer. Nothing is sent over the internet.
Localization.note.trademark: Soundpad is a product of Leppsoft. This plugin is not affiliated with Leppsoft or Ulanzi.
Localization.hint.not-running: Open Soundpad. The keys connect by themselves, and retry every few seconds.
Localization.hint.denied: Windows refused the connection. Run Soundpad and Ulanzi Studio as the same user, both as administrator or neither.
Localization.hint.pipe-busy: Another program is using Soundpad's remote control right now. It will try again.
Localization.hint.timeout: Soundpad did not answer in time. It will try again.
Localization.hint.closed: Soundpad closed the connection. It will try again.
Localization.hint.unexpected: Soundpad answered something unexpected. If this repeats, update Soundpad.
Localization.hint.incompatible: This version of Soundpad has no remote control. Update Soundpad.
Localization.hint.trial: Soundpad trial: Leppsoft limits some features in it.
Localization.library.waiting: The list appears once Soundpad connects.
Localization.results.some: Showing {shown} of {total}. Type to narrow down.
Localization.sound.relinked: The file moved, so it was found by its name, artist and length.
Localization.sound.missing: This sound is no longer in Soundpad. Choose another.
Localization.sound.ambiguous: Several sounds match the saved one. Choose it again.
Localization.sound.unset: Choose a sound from the list.
Localization.preview.missing: That sound is no longer in Soundpad.
